description: This source file defines a Java interface for events indicating that a 'Thing' was modified within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends a generic 'ThingEvent' interface and includes a method to set headers related to Ditto.

classes.name: ThingModifiedEvent
classes.description: An interface representing an event triggered after a 'Thing' has been modified, with a generic type parameter for chaining methods.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the event, returning the instance for chaining.
